tv_script_name: Apex Fusion AI| Smart Trend Engine
indentation_source: direct DOM extraction (monaco-editor-tv-pine-dark content spans), grouped by bounding-box top coordinate into lines
notes: Despite the marketing name ('AI', 'Institutional POC Approximation'), the actual mechanism is a plain weighted-confluence scoring system over 6 conventional signals (200-EMA trend, Supertrend direction, volume spike vs 20-MA, MACD histogram slope, N-bar momentum, fractal-pivot break-of-structure, Fibonacci retracement zone, and a naive highest-volume-bar 'POC' proxy) -- enter when the weighted score crosses a threshold (default 80/100). No ML/AI code, no session or intrabar-recalc logic. Author's doc: 'Works on every timeframe, with particularly strong performance on the 1H chart' -- not intraday-exclusive. 139 lines, 9 params.
